name: When There Is No More Snow
source:
When There Is No More Snow is a HYPER LOW RES SUPER RETRO visual novel made in ZZT! It's a semi-autobiographical story about a bunch of 8th graders in rural Michigan in 1995.

[From [url=https://whydoisay.itch.io/when-there-is-no-more-snow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《When There Is No More Snow》是一部用ZZT制作、分辨率低得惊人、复古感十足的视觉小说！这是一个半自传性质的故事，讲述1995年密歇根乡下一群八年级学生的生活。

[摘自[url=https://whydoisay.itch.io/when-there-is-no-more-snow]itch.io[/url]]
